name: season-windows-uk-ramp
description: Pothos (let_top_dry, 7 days, rest factor 1.5) watered on 2026-10-17 in the UK (55 N): halfway up the ramp the factor is 1.25, so the interval is 9 days, between 7 (growth) and 11 (rest).
why: Factor = 1 + weight x (restFactor - 1) = 1 + 0.5 x 0.5 = 1.25; 7 x 1.25 = 8.75 rounds half up to 9. let_top_dry band 25% early (2) and late (2): 2026-10-17 + 9 - 2 = 2026-10-24 and + 9 + 2 = 2026-10-28. The hard switch gave 7.
